class.name: SpinePathConstraintPose
class.brief_description: Stores a pose for a path constraint.
class.description: Stores the current pose values for a path constraint. Path constraints position and rotate bones along a path defined by a slot's attachment.

method.name: get_position
method.description: Returns the position along the path.

method.name: set_position
method.description: Sets the position along the path.

method.name: get_mix_rotate
method.description: Returns a percentage (0-1) that controls the mix between the constrained and unconstrained rotation.

method.name: set_mix_rotate
method.description: Sets a percentage (0-1) that controls the mix between the constrained and unconstrained rotation.

method.name: get_mix_x
method.description: Returns a percentage (0-1) that controls the mix between the constrained and unconstrained translation X.

method.name: set_mix_x
method.description: Sets a percentage (0-1) that controls the mix between the constrained and unconstrained translation X.

method.name: get_mix_y
method.description: Returns a percentage (0-1) that controls the mix between the constrained and unconstrained translation Y.

method.name: set_mix_y
method.description: Sets a percentage (0-1) that controls the mix between the constrained and unconstrained translation Y.

members.member: The position of the first constrained bone along the path, interpreted according to the constraint data's position mode.
The spacing between constrained bones along the path, interpreted according to the constraint data's spacing mode.
The percentage from 0 to 1 used to mix between unconstrained and path-constrained rotation.
The percentage from 0 to 1 used to mix between unconstrained and path-constrained X translation.
The percentage from 0 to 1 used to mix between unconstrained and path-constrained Y translation.
